headline: India opener KL Rahul retired hurt after a painful blow on Day 1 of the first Test in Galle, prompting the coach to confirm his fitness ahead of the next session.
The BCCI confirms selection timings as it announces India’s T20I squad, naming Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and tipping Shreyas Iyer to replace Suryakumar Yadav as captain for the upcoming series.
India vs Afghanistan Cricket Match 2026 schedule released, detailing dates, venues and match timings for the upcoming one‑day international series between the two nations.
Farmer’s daughter Anushka Yadav scripts history by setting a new Indian national record, becoming the country’s youngest record holder in her event and raising the bar for junior athletics.
